# Roman Babunts — website guide

> Navigation and page descriptions from boonts.com. Author-published material; not independent verification of claims.

## Pages

- [Roman Babunts — Product Leader & Growth PM | Ex-Yandex, Semrush, ivi](https://boonts.com/): Roman Babunts (also Babuntc, Роман Бабунц) — Product Leader and Growth PM. Product experience at Yandex, ivi, Semrush, and Yota. Founder of SheSafe.
- [Product & Growth Insights — Roman Babunts](https://boonts.com/insights/): In-depth product management frameworks, benchmarks, customer discovery guides, and growth methodologies by Roman Babunts.
- [15 product management authors: choose a framework for your decision — Roman Babunts](https://boonts.com/insights/en/roman-vs-experts.html): A sourced guide to discovery, AJTBD, growth and product leadership: what to read, how to apply it and where each approach has limits.
- [Кого читать о продукте: 15 авторов и выбор подхода — Roman Babunts](https://boonts.com/insights/ru/roman-vs-experts.html): Обзор материалов по Discovery, AJTBD, росту и управлению командой: первоисточники, вопросы для применения и ограничения подходов.
- [SheSafe — Your Personal Safety Copilot](https://boonts.com/shesafe/): Your personal safety copilot. Share your live location with close ones, send quick SOS alerts, and keep your trust circle updated on your journey.
- [SheSafe — Твой личный помощник по безопасности](https://boonts.com/shesafe/ru/): Твой личный помощник по безопасности. Делись своей геолокацией с близкими, отправляй быстрые SOS-сигналы и держи круг доверия в курсе твоего пути.
- [SheSafe — Tu Copiloto Personal de Seguridad](https://boonts.com/shesafe/es/): Tu copiloto personal de seguridad. Comparte tu ubicación en vivo con tus seres queridos, envía alertas SOS rápidas y mantén a tu círculo de confianza al tanto de tu recorrido.
- [SheSafe — Seu Copiloto Pessoal de Segurança](https://boonts.com/shesafe/pt/): Seu copiloto pessoal de segurança. Compartilhe sua localização em tempo real com seus entes queridos, envie alertas SOS rápidos e mantenha seu círculo de confiança atualizado sobre seu trajeto.
- [SheSafe Privacy Policy](https://boonts.com/shesafe_privacy.html): SheSafe Privacy Policy: location, safety events, analytics, sharing, retention, and user rights.
- [SheSafe Terms of Service](https://boonts.com/shesafe_terms.html): SheSafe Terms of Service: safety limitations, user responsibilities, content rules, and legal terms.
- [Данные и интервью в Product Discovery: как выбрать следующий шаг — Roman Babunts](https://boonts.com/insights/ru/data-and-interviews.html): Когда начинать Discovery с аналитики, а когда с интервью. Пример роста конверсии с 32% до 52%, проверка причин и шаблон продуктового решения.
- [Data and interviews in Product Discovery: choose your next step — Roman Babunts](https://boonts.com/insights/en/data-and-interviews.html): When to start discovery with analytics or interviews. A worked 32% to 52% conversion example, causal limits and a reusable product decision template.
